sections.heading: Abstract
sections.text: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on recurrent networks. We propose the Transformer.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Recurrent models have cost $O(n^{2})$ per layer.

Sequence models have long relied on recurrence and convolution to relate positions in a sentence. Recurrent computation is inherently sequential, which limits parallelism within a training example and becomes a bottleneck for longer sequences, because memory constraints limit batching across examples. We argue that attention alone can model these dependencies and describe an architecture, the Transformer, that dispenses with recurrence and relies entirely on attention to draw global dependencies between input and output.

title: Attention is all you need
